title: A newcomer reads Docs at desktop and phone widths: overview, first item, readable diagrams, FAQ and reference
description: A real browser on the served dashboard at 1440px and 390px opens Docs (Help), follows the page's own links and the keyboard from who decides what through the first-item journey, the delivery flow and where-things-run diagrams, the FAQ and the folded reference; finds concrete answers on shared context, delivery, Railway or AWS deployment and access across installs; every on-page link lands; the page never scrolls sideways; diagram labels are at least 14 CSS px with no card, label or arrow overlapping; and a full-page screenshot per width is kept.
